operations.name: Charles Eddy

expected.charges: Banished without trial to Winchester, Virginia (September 1777) as a "Virginia Exile".
expected.sentence: Banished about seven months to Winchester, Virginia; released in the spring of 1778.

operations.research_note: Gilpin, Exiles in Virginia (1848), p.67 individual Lodge confinement dates; pp.230-232 and 281-282: April 27, 1778 Council discharge and individual pass deemed discharge. April 30 is homecoming, not substituted for discharge. Drinker primary journal gives Sep3 despite conflicting later diary transcriptions. Compulsory Winchester detention allowed movement but men remained prisoners until discharge. No biography or case notes changes.
